content: Chay ganchris cöpachru cayagtam angelcunaga jirparärin
Chaypitam mayarü gayacuypanuy Diospa cacunanpita, chay ganchris angelcuna cay nimugta: “Aywapäcuy, wac pachaman jirpapäcamuy chay ganchris cöpachru cayagta lutan runacuna cunchupäcunanpag”.

Nimuptinga galayunancag angelmi yargorun. Jinarcurmi jirparamun cay pachaman. Chauraga chay animal niragwan unanchächicusha runacunachrümi jinaman chay animal nirayagta runacuna rurapäcunganta alawag runacunachrümi, ricacarun alisca nanag gueri gueshya.
Nätan guepancag angelga jirparamun cöpachru cayagtaga jatun gochramanmi. Jinarcurmi gochraga muyurun wanushapa yawarninnuyman. Chauraga lapan cawagmi chay gochrachrüga wanurärin.
Chaynuytan mas guepancag angelsi cöpanta jirparamun mayucunaman, pucyucunaman. Jinarcurmi yacucunaga muyurärin yawarman.
Chaura yacucunata munayninchru cachig angeltaga mayarü cay nigtam:

content.text: “Munayniyog Dios, gamga cayanqui ali ruragmi caynuypa cunchuchir.
Gamga cayanqui lapan juchacunapita caruchrümi unaypita canancamas.
Paycunaga Diospa raquishancunatam, Diospa willacugnincunatam wanuchipäcusha,
chay jinapäcunganpitam gamsi yacuta yawarman muyurachinqui upyapäcunanpag. Chaynuy rurar alitam rurayanqui” nigta.

content: Chaypita juctas mayarütan altarcagpita cay nimugta:

content.text: gamga cunchuyächinqui razoncagpitam, nätan alitam rurayanqui” nimugta.

content: Chaypita chay mas guepan chruscucag angelga jirpurun cöpachru cayagta intiman, jinarcurmi usyaga runacuna rupayta galacuyun.

Chaura chay rupasha runacunaga, juchancunapita wanacurcänan trucaga, jinaman Diosta alawapäcunan trucaga antis ashliytam galacayärin, chay gueri nirag gueshyawan cunchuchinanpag Dios munayniyog cayaptinsi.

Chaypitam chay mas guepan pichgacag angelga, jirpurun cöpachru cayagtaga, chay manchacuypag animal mandayangancagman. Jinarcurmi pay mandanganga mayag chayagchrüsi pasay yanauyarun. Chauraga nanaylapitam galluncunatas cachrucurcänag.
Jinamanga jana pachachru Dios ashliytam galacayärin chay nanaywan, jinaman chay guerincuna nanaptin. Nätan manatan wanacurcarachu chay lutan ruraynincunapitaga.

Chaypitam chay mas guepancag angelga cöpachru cayagtaga jirpurun, Eufrates ningan jatun mayuman. Jinarcurmi chay mayuga chaquirun, inti yargamunan lädupita aywamug reycuna alisca chranin soldäduncunawan pasapäcunanpag.
Chaypitam ricapurü quima lutan espiritucuna ränasnuy yargamugta. Jucga yargamunag Asyagpa shiminpitam, jucagmi animalpa shiminpita, jinaman jucmi Asyagpa willacugninpa shiminpita.

Chaycunaga canag Asyagpa lutan espirituncunam, jinaman chaycunaga rurapäcunag runala mana ruray atipänantam. Jinarcurmi chaycunaga aywacurcan cay pachachru mandagcunata soldäduntintawan gotumug, ushanan junagchru chay ima-aygas ruray atipag Diosta guërrata rurapäcunanpag.

Shumag mayapäcuy cay nir rimanganta: “Nogaga juc suwanuysi aywamushag mayänitam. Cushisham canga pisi ricchayar cayagnuysi shuyäcamagga, jinaman jacupacushanuyla shuyäcamagga. Chauraga manam pisi garapachranuy pengacusha puringachu” nir rimanganta.
Jinarcurmi chay espiritucunaga runacunata goturärin ‘Armagedón’ ninganman. ‘Armagedonga’ hebreo rimaychrüga ‘Meguido’ gotu ninanmi.

Chaypitam chay ushanancag angelga jirpurun cöpachru cayagtaga walyayman. Jinarcurmi Diospa cacunan wayin nirayagpitaga, chay trönuncagpitaga, gayacuypanuy rimaramun cay nir: “Caywanga nä ruracarun lapanmi” nir.
Chauraga galacuyun lipaytam, räyuytam, alisca wagariytam, jinaman alisca pacha cuyuytam. Chaynuy pacha cuyuyga manam imaysi carachu cay pachachru runacuna canganpita-pachas.

Jinarcurmi chay jatun marcaga particarun quimaman. Nätan nacioncunachru marcacunam juchrurärin. Chaynuyta ricarur Diosga yarparun, chay jatuncaray Babilonia marcata alisca piñasha cunchuchinanpag ningantam.
Jinamanmi lapan tishgocuna illacarun. Chaynuytan jircacunas mana canagchu.

Chaura runacunamanga jana pachapitam alisca acray runtu tamya galacuyun, juc quintalnuy lasagcama. Jinarcurmi runacunaga Diospag ima-aygas lutanta rimacurcan, chay runtu tamyawan alisca juyunaypa cunchuchinganpita.
